messages.subject: RE: Gareth Hollis — settlement agreement (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Ashworth,

Without prejudice and subject to contract. We accept the ex gratia at £90,000, the costs contribution at £750 plus VAT and the six-month non-compete. Our further mark-up is attached (v3): we have added a re-engagement/clawback condition on the ex gratia (clause 3.5) and a short addition to the tax indemnity requiring your client's reasonable assistance on any HMRC enquiry. Vested options are preserved under the scheme rules, as recorded in clause 4.1. Subject to these, we believe we are agreed.

Kind regards,
James Osei

James Osei
Senior Associate, Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Osei,

Agreed. The clawback is acceptable as drafted (six-month look-back, pro-rated repayment) and our client will give the tax-assistance wording. We will arrange the adviser's certificate. Please send an execution version for signature in the new year, with the Termination Date as 31 January 2026.

Regards,
Marcus Ashworth
